description: Asks for an independent second review of content the cold-email firewall refused (`cold_email_prohibited`), given the same agent, subject and body the refused send used. Returns `outcome`: `overturned` (that exact content may be sent for the next 24 hours), `upheld`, `not_appealable` (a fixed policy block, with no review) or `not_blocked`. Within 24 hours the same content gets back the outcome it was given, never a new review. At most 10 appeals per workspace per 24 hours.

agent.description: Agent name or id the refused send used. Optional — omitted, the workspace's single agent is assumed (the refused send itself created one if none existed).

name: mails_emails_appeal
title: Appeal a refused send
